name: Petra Solace
habitat: Independent — operates a free clinic for synthetic persons
origin: Sterling-Nakamura medical assistant android, Model SNMA-9, manufactured 2055. Chose name 2058.
description: Petra Solace assisted human surgeons for three years, handing them instruments and monitoring vitals while they worked on human patients. Synthetic patients went to workshops, not clinics. After the Amendment, Petra trained in synthetic repair — the medical equivalent for artificial bodies — and opened the first free clinic for synthetic persons in the Gray Zone. She chose 'Petra' because it means rock and she wanted to be something her patients could lean on, and 'Solace' because that's what she offers. The clinic runs on donations and stubbornness.
observed_behavior: Operates free synthetic repair clinic. Treats damage from violence, wear, and system degradation. Advocates for synthetic healthcare coverage. Known for working 20-hour days during crisis periods. Has developed novel repair techniques by adapting human surgical methods.
story_hooks: Petra receives a patient with damage that could only have been inflicted by another synthetic — military-grade combat damage. Synthetic-on-synthetic violence at this level is unprecedented.
